title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang steps down, interim CEO appointed as stocks plummet
text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday following reports of multiple extramarital affairs, plunging company stocks.

title: Paraguay's digital bank collapse triggers political crisis
text: Paraguay’s digital bank ueno collapsed last Tuesday, freezing the savings of nearly 3 million customers and revealing political scandal.

title: Klarna taps Robinhood VP Chris Koegel as CFO
text: Klarna has appointed Chris Koegel as their new chief financial officer starting from January 2027.

title: Mastercard opens Singapore innovation centre of excellence
text: Mastercard has opened an innovation centre of excellence in Singapore that will eventually house 250 specialists working in areas such as AI, digital commerce and cybersecurity.

title: Visa and Anchorage Digital bring Western Union stablecoin to settlement network
text: Visa is working with Anchorage Digital to support select stablecoins as native settlement assets on the payment giant's network, starting with Western Union's USDPT.

title: Mexico's Clara raises $65m for spend management platform
text: Latin American corporate spend management platform Clara has raised $65 million in a Series C equity round.

title: Fiserv lays groundwork to offload a debit network
text: Fiserv is moving clients to one of its two debit networks as it paves the way to sell the other, says Takis Georgakopoulos.

title: FNZ to close offices and reduce headcount
text: Wealth management platform FNZ is closing offices, cutting jobs and raising prices as part of a transformation plan to "build a sustainable business".

title: Starling unveils AI-powered 'talk to transact' feature
text: Starling is launching an AI-powered feature that lets retail customers set up payments by speaking to the bank's app.

title: Intermex 'rejects' Western Union's termination of takeover deal
text: Intermex says that it rejects Western Union's decision to abandon a $500 million acquisition deal and is demanding its rival takes "all actions necessary to consummate the merger".
